def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        expanded = []
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            expanded.extend([value] * (2 if c in (0, w - 1) else 1))
        out.extend([expanded] * (2 if r in (0, h - 1) else 1))
    return out
